body.name: \(\mathfrak H_0\)
body.construction: Whenever \(\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)\ne\varnothing\), define \(\mathfrak H_0=\{\mathcal C:\mathcal C(Y_0,Y_1)\subseteq[-B,B]^N\text{ is measurable and compact, and }\inf_{\vartheta\in\mathcal M_{T_0,T_1}(0)}\Pr_\vartheta\{\beta\in\mathcal C(Y_0,Y_1)\}\ge1-\alpha\}\).
